meta.subject: Added write mask to AccumulatorMem and increased output bitwidth of 64-by-64 systolic arrays in EE290-2 lab configs

en.summary: This mixed commit contains a real accumulator-memory correctness fix: masked writes into AccumulatorMem were not propagated to the underlying SRAM, so partial writes could overwrite untouched byte lanes instead of preserving prior accumulator contents.
why_it_counts: The patch changes on-chip memory write semantics in the accelerator datapath, not only configuration files.
AccumulatorMem, Scratchpad, ExecuteController, and SyncMem are all updated together to carry and honor write masks.
Ignoring a partial-write mask is a real DUT data-corruption mechanism for accumulator-backed writes.
disqualifiers: The same commit also changes lab-specific output-width configurations.
evidence: AccumulatorMem.scala adds a mask field to AccumulatorWriteIO, buffers it, and drives mem.io.mask.
SyncMem.scala changes TwoPortSyncMem to a masked SyncReadMem write using Vec(mask_len, mask_elem).
Scratchpad.scala stops discarding accumulator write masks and forwards io.acc.write(i).mask / reader.module.io.resp.bits.mask.
ExecuteController.scala drives the accumulator write mask high for full writes so the new masked interface is exercised consistently.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The bug is a partial-write masking failure in an accumulator or scratchpad memory. A DMA response or compute write may update only a subset of byte lanes or subelements in a row, but if the memory write path ignores the mask, the design overwrites the whole row with new data and destroys previously stored accumulator values in untouched lanes.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: masked accumulator or scratchpad row writeback
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A write carries a byte-enable or lane mask because the transfer width or alignment does not cover the full memory row
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drop the write mask between the producer and the physical memory array so every partial write becomes a full-row overwrite.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: ignore byte-enable mask on memory write
portability_notes: Map the bug to any local SRAM or accumulator bank that supports masked or partial updates.
A mask drop can happen either at the memory primitive boundary or earlier when the producer fails to forward the mask.
The expected corruption is preserved old data being replaced in supposedly untouched byte lanes.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the row-write path that carries data plus a byte-enable or lane mask.
Force the memory array to treat all mask bits as enabled, or disconnect the propagated mask and substitute all ones.
Retain the rest of the data path so corruption only appears on partial-width or non-full-row writes.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AccumulatorMem masked write path from producer IO through TwoPortSyncMem
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds a write-mask field to accumulator writes, propagates it through the scratchpad/execution path, and changes the backing dual-port memory primitive to perform masked writes.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the accumulator mask propagation in Scratchpad/AccumulatorMem or force SyncMem's masked write interface to write all lanes regardless of io.mask.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Partial accumulator or DMA-backed writes corrupt adjacent byte lanes or previously accumulated values that should have remained unchanged.
evidence_for_injection: Before the fix, accumulator masks were explicitly commented out in Scratchpad.scala.
The backing memory primitive itself was widened to accept a mask, showing the bug was not only at the interface boundary.
The fix buffers the mask through the accumulator write pipeline, which is necessary only if partial writes were semantically important.
notes: A clean reinjection is to keep the new interface but hardwire the mask to all ones at the memory-array boundary.

zh.summary: 这个混合提交中包含真实的 accumulator memory 正确性修复：写入 AccumulatorMem 时的掩码没有被传递到底层 SRAM，因此部分写会覆盖本应保持不变的 byte lane，而不是保留原有 accumulator 内容。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是加速器数据通路中的片上存储写语义，而不只是配置文件。
AccumulatorMem、Scratchpad、ExecuteController 和 SyncMem 被一起修改，用于传递并执行写掩码。
忽略部分写掩码会造成 accumulator 支撑写入时的真实数据损坏。
disqualifiers: 同一个提交也修改了实验用配置里的输出位宽。
evidence: AccumulatorMem.scala 为 AccumulatorWriteIO 增加了 mask 字段，进行了流水缓存，并驱动 mem.io.mask。
SyncMem.scala 把 TwoPortSyncMem 改成带 mask 的 SyncReadMem 写，使用 Vec(mask_len, mask_elem)。
Scratchpad.scala 不再丢弃 accumulator 写掩码，而是转发 io.acc.write(i).mask 和 reader.module.io.resp.bits.mask。
ExecuteController.scala 在全宽写入时显式驱动 accumulator 写掩码全 1，使新的 masked 接口被一致使用。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该缺陷属于 accumulator 或 scratchpad memory 的部分写掩码失效。DMA 返回或计算写入可能只更新一行中的部分 byte lane 或子元素；如果存储写路径忽略了这个 mask，设计就会用新数据覆盖整行，从而破坏那些本应保留的旧 accumulator 值。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 带掩码的 accumulator 或 scratchpad 行写回
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 写请求携带 byte-enable 或 lane mask，因为传输宽度或对齐方式没有覆盖整行
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在生产者与物理存储阵列之间丢弃写掩码，使每次部分写都变成整行覆盖。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 在存储写时忽略 byte-enable 掩码
portability_notes: 把该缺陷映射到任何支持掩码或部分更新的本地 SRAM/accumulator bank。
mask 丢失既可能发生在 memory primitive 边界，也可能更早发生在生产者没有转发 mask 的地方。
预期损坏形式是：本应保持的旧数据被新写入错误覆盖。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位携带 data 和 byte-enable/lane mask 的行写路径。
强制存储阵列把所有 mask 位都当成有效，或切断 mask 传递并替换成全 1。
保持其他数据通路不变，使损坏只在部分宽度或非整行写场景下出现。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 从生产者 IO 到 TwoPortSyncMem 的 AccumulatorMem 带掩码写路径
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复为 accumulator 写加入掩码字段，通过 scratchpad/execute 路径传播，并把底层双端口存储原语改为真正执行 masked write。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 Scratchpad/AccumulatorMem 中的 accumulator mask 传递，或让 SyncMem 的 masked write 接口无论 io.mask 如何都写所有 lane。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 部分 accumulator 写或 DMA 支撑写会破坏相邻 byte lane，或覆盖本应保持的累加结果。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前，Scratchpad.scala 中关于 accumulator mask 的代码是被注释掉的。
底层 memory primitive 本身也被修改为支持 mask，说明问题不只是接口边界遗漏。
修复把 mask 通过 accumulator 写流水缓存下来，表明部分写在语义上确实重要。
notes: 最干净的回注入方式是保留新接口，但在 memory-array 边界把 mask 强制成全 1。
